title: The Raiders' Nest
text: The raids on the outer farms were never bandits; the bodies were eaten, not robbed. Tracks lead back through the Rift Gate to a den in the Beast Lands, and each moon the beasts learn the way a little better. It has to be burned out this Year.

options.label: Strip the armories to arm the party, so the den burns this Year.

outcomes.text: Every House gives up iron for spearheads while the smiths work through the night.

options.label: Leave a herd out as bait to draw the beasts from their den.

outcomes.text: The beasts take the bait. When the party comes, the den is half empty.
The beasts take the bait, then come back for more.

options.label: Bar the farms and wait for the party to do its work.

outcomes.text: The farmers sleep in the town square until it is done, and they do not sleep well.
